_doc: Tech inspection checklist for the team tracker (Tracker in the app): FSAE 2027 IC, paraphrased by rule number; read the rulebook for the exact wording. how: solver = the workbench measures it, car, cad, docs = paperwork.

items.item: Structural Equivalency Spreadsheet (SES) submitted and approved before the deadline
Impact Attenuator Data report submitted (standard attenuator or test data)
Electronic throttle documentation submitted, if the car uses electronic throttle (otherwise doesn't apply)
Team has read the inspection sheet and pre-inspected the car against it
Open wheels: nothing in the tire keep-out zones, top half of the tires clear from above
Wheelbase at least 1525 mm; smaller track at least 75 % of the larger
Ground clearance in motion and lower side impact structure height
Usable wheel travel at least 50 mm with the driver seated; suspension mounts visible
Steering: stops before lock-up, under 7° free play, rack mechanically attached
Wheels at least 8 in; single-nut wheels have positive retention
Suspension mounts not on the span of the Main Hoop or its braces away from the nodes
Pickups land on the frame (frame changes list, 7 items)
Tube sizes and material match the SES
Driver template: 95th percentile helmet 50 mm under the hoop lines, 915 mm to the pedals
Front and Main Hoop angles and heights; Front Hoop over the steering wheel
Main Hoop braces: attached within 160 mm of the top, 30° or more to the hoop
Steering protection
Front bulkhead and its support
Side Impact Structure, upper member 290-345 mm above the lower one's lowest point
Shoulder harness mounting bar
Anti Intrusion Plate and Impact Attenuator fitted as documented
Fuel system location and protection
Cockpit opening and internal cross section pass the templates
Moving suspension and steering parts in the cockpit covered by a solid shield
Floor closeout and firewall
Harness meets the spec and is in date
Lap and shoulder belt angles and shoulder belt spacing
Anti-submarine belt mounting
Head restraint; roll bar padding
Driver visibility (mirrors)
Egress test: every driver out in time
Brakes can lock all four wheels with a design pedal force
Two independent hydraulic circuits with separate reservoirs
Pedal and system take 2000 N
Brake Over Travel Switch
Brake light visible in bright sunlight
Drive chain or belt guards and scatter shields
Coolant (water only)
Systems sealed; catch cans
Engine within the limits
Intake: location, mounting and restrictor
Throttle and return springs
Fuel tank, filler neck and sight tube, venting, fuel lines
Exhaust protection and the noise test
Final drive chosen (Car view, Drivetrain: final drive sweep)
Starter, batteries, voltage limit
Shutdown circuit, primary master switch, cockpit main switch
Low voltage battery mounting; inertia switch
Electronic throttle checks and BSPD, if the car uses electronic throttle
Critical fasteners: grade, head type, threads past the nut
Positive locking on every critical fastener (nyloc only below 80 °C)
Rod ends and spherical bearings in double shear or captured
Car numbers, school name, SAE logo, transponder
Jacking point and push bar
Fire extinguishers
Driver equipment: helmet, suit, gloves, shoes, balaclava
Tilt test
Driver template clearance on the car
Brake test at the event
